'''Markus Wüst Elektrochemie LK''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Markus Wüst]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-16187">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16187 Elektrochemie LK], DeckTech (Markus "Lone Gunner" Wuest, 25 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16187/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16187/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Markus Wüst]]
* '''Published:''' 25 May 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Elektrochemie LK''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 HD Wust DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' I just wanted to post my Hunt Down version....only lost once in tourney play at Bochum, Germany

== Original post ==

'''Elektrochemie LK'''
* '''Author:''' Markus "Lone Gunner" Wuest
* '''Published:''' May 25, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' I just wanted to post my Hunt Down version....only lost once in tourney play at Bochum, Germany

=== Strategy ===

kay, its just a Hunt Down deck, but it served me well during the last 4 tournaments in Bochum....so i decided to post it....

Its pretty obvious how to play it....
